name: Klemmbaustein 2 x 4
description: Simple brick designed for LEGO compatibility: eight studs on an 8 mm grid, an open underside, and three clutch tubes. Body: 31.8 x 15.8 x 9.6 mm; total height with studs: 11.4 mm. Print at 100% scale with the open underside on the bed and studs up, supports off, and 0.12-0.16 mm layers. Use elephant-foot compensation and inspect the first roof bridge in the slicer. Physical clutch fit is unverified and depends on printer and material: test one brick first. Adjust FIT_ADJUSTMENT in generate.py in 0.025 mm steps (positive for looser, negative for tighter) and regenerate if needed.
